description: Parse or format an ISO 8601 duration. With mode "parse", break a duration string like "P3DT4H30M" into its components and a total number of seconds (years and months use nominal 365-day / 30-day conversions and set an "approximate" flag). With mode "format", render a non-negative number of seconds into a canonical duration string using days/hours/minutes/seconds.

input.description: The ISO 8601 duration to parse (required when mode is "parse")

mode.description: parse an ISO string, or format a number of seconds

seconds.description: The number of seconds to format (required when mode is "format")

name: convert_iso8601_duration
